newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian O/N rates firm in tight market.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian O/N rates firm in tight market.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates ended higher after a session of tight liquidity, dealers said.
Overnight rates finished at 27.5/28 percent, up from Tuesday's close of 26.50 percent.
"Banks were taking money up at levels above the repo rates," said Pal Szucs of Hypo-Bank Hungaria. "There's a huge lack of liquidity as everybody is seeking money," he said.
The central bank's overnight and one-week repo rates were equally 27.75 percent.
